_comment: Keyword list used to triage which pages of a BRSR PDF get sent to the LLM for extraction. Edit freely — add terms as you find gaps during review. Matching is case-insensitive substring matching, so keep entries as short/canonical as reasonably possible.
_comment_anchors: These aren't keywords to scan for — they're BRSR section headers used to locate Principle 3 and Principle 5 (the sections SEBI's format requires disability/accessibility disclosure under, even when a company's discussion is minimal). The extraction script finds and includes these sections regardless of keyword hits.

table_headers: measures for the well-being of employees
